title: Four cards
intro: Each card has a number on one side and a colour on the other. You are told: 'If a card shows an even number on one face, then its opposite face is blue.'
question: Which card(s) must you turn over to test whether the rule is true? Select all that apply.
debrief: Only the 8 (an even number could hide a non-blue face) and the Red card (it could hide an even number) can falsify the rule. Turning the Blue card cannot: the rule says nothing about what is behind blue. Fewer than 10% choose 8 and Red; most choose 8 and Blue, looking for confirmation rather than refutation.
